assessments.evidence: The company shall not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from technical interruptions or system downtime during the submission process.
assessments.reason: This clause deals with technical liability and does not concern data breach notifications.

assessments.evidence: The applicant explicitly waives any standing right to inspect, review, or obtain copies of stored evaluation files, and acknowledges that requests for the permanent removal of submitted records shall not be entertained under any circumstances following submission.
assessments.reason: It explicitly denies data subjects their statutory rights to access and request the destruction of their personal data.

assessments.evidence: Any formal notices required under these terms must be delivered in writing to the primary corporate headquarters address specified on the official company website.
assessments.reason: This clause establishes notice delivery procedures and does not impose excessive data collection.
